mainEntity.name: Do industrial buyers really use ChatGPT to find suppliers?

acceptedAnswer.text: More every month. AI is still about 0.25% of total traffic in Ahrefs' 2026 data, but Google's lead over AI assistants fell from roughly 345x to 210x. Pages that rank in Google are also the pages AI engines read first, so the same build covers both.

mainEntity.name: We sell through distributors. Does this still make sense?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, if buyers search for your product or application by name. Pages can route RFQs to the right distributor by region and make sure your brand is the one the AI answer names.

mainEntity.name: How fast do the first leads come in?

acceptedAnswer.text: The first 20 pages go live in weeks 3 to 6. Published industrial cases from the wider market show first inbound leads in 12 to 75 days, depending on niche and catalog depth.

mainEntity.name: Do we need to rebuild our website?

acceptedAnswer.text: Usually not. New pages can be added to the current site or a subfolder, as long as they render as plain HTML.
